exposure: Treatment for 'mild' Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) defined by IADPSG-only criteria
Treatment for 'mild' GDM defined by ADIPS1998-only criteria
cohort: The study included 17,512 pregnant women from six tertiary hospitals in Sydney, Australia, who were screened for GDM using a three-point 75g oral glucose tolerance test between 2016-2017.
finding: Treatment of women with IADPSG-only GDM was associated with fewer large for gestational age infants, but treatment for ADIPS1998-only GDM did not significantly alter pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Treatment for IADPSG-only GDM was associated with an increased rate of induction of labour.
